title: Mortgage rates surge to 7.22% as rising costs impact Connecticut housing market
excerpt: Average 30-year fixed mortgage rates in Connecticut have climbed to around 7.22%, cooling some buyer competition, though home price cuts continue to trail the rest of the...
content:
Average 30-year fixed mortgage rates in Connecticut have climbed to around 7.22%, cooling some buyer competition, though home price cuts continue to trail the rest of the nation as inventory remains tight across Hartford, New Haven, and Fairfield counties.

With rising borrowing costs, Connecticut homebuyers and sellers must navigate market conditions with strategic pricing and experienced guidance. According to regional housing metrics, while higher rates have moderated the frenzy of bidding wars in some price brackets, well-maintained single-family properties in prime school districts continue to attract strong attention.

At Sharif Realty Group, we monitor daily rate fluctuations, local absorption rates, and lender programs to help buyers identify the right financing strategies and enable sellers to price precisely for maximum net proceeds.

For personalized guidance on purchasing or selling in today's dynamic Connecticut market, contact Majeed Sharif at (203) 802-8099 or email Sharifrealty19@gmail.com.
author: Majeed Sharif

title: NAR Pending Home Sales Report Shows 1.9% Increase in October
content:
The National Association of Realtors' Pending Home Sales Report recorded a 1.9% increase in contract signings in October, reflecting robust homebuyer demand and strong transaction activity across the nation.

All four major U.S. regions posted month-over-month contract gains, signaling enduring momentum heading into the upcoming quarters.
